raw.details:
Welcome to UTOPIA STOCK EXCHANGE, an exciting virtual stock market simulation hosted by IBS Pune as part of ZEAL 2026 – Utopia!

Step Into the World of Financial Markets, Where Every Decision Counts, Every Fluctuation Creates an Opportunity, and Every Trade Can Make or Break Your Portfolio.

Get ready to experience the thrill of the stock market without risking real money! with virtual capital in your hands, analyse market movements, track company performance, react to breaking news and make strategic investment decisions to maximise your returns.

but remember, the market rewards those who think ahead!

What's in Store?

  • Virtual Capital: start Your Trading Journey with ₹1,50,000 in Virtual Investment Capital.
  • 50–60 Companies: explore a Diverse Range of Companies Across Different Sectors.
  • Buy, Sell or Hold: Make Strategic Decisions Based on Market Conditions.
  • Dynamic Market: react to News, Market Developments and Changing Stock Prices.
  • Live Portfolio Tracking: Monitor Your Investments, Portfolio Value and Profit & Loss (p&l).
  • Competitive Trading: Compete with Fellow Participants and Aim to Outperform the Market.

Your Mission:

Build a powerful portfolio, make smart investment choices and maximise your virtual wealth.

Will you play it safe, take calculated risks or spot the next big market opportunity?

The Challenge is to make every rupee count!

Who Can Participate?

Students Passionate About:

  • Finance and Investment
  • Stock Market and Trading
  • Business and Economics
  • Strategic Thinking and Decision-Making

No real-money investment is required. bring your analytical mindset, market curiosity and competitive spirit!

Event Details:

Event: utopia Stock Exchange
Date: 11 December 2026
Venue: IBS Pune, Hadapsar, Pune
Organised By: IBS Pune
Fest: Zeal 2026 – Utopia

Why Should You Participate?

  • Experience a Simulated Stock Market Environment.
  • Test Your Financial and Analytical Skills.
  • Learn to Make Decisions Under Market Pressure.
  • Understand the Impact of Market Movements and News.
  • Challenge Yourself Against Other Aspiring Investors.

The Market Never Waits!

Fortunes Can Change in Seconds. Opportunities Won't Knock Twice. One Smart Move Could Put You Ahead of Everyone Else.

Are You Ready to Turn Virtual Capital Into a Winning Portfolio?

Register Now and Let Your Trading Jour
